# Rosary Plant House

Rosary Plant House is a Coonoor, Tamil Nadu nursery selling succulents, cacti, indoor plants, balcony plants and plant care guidance online.

## Canonical Public Pages

- Home: https://rosaryplanthouse.com/
- Shop: https://rosaryplanthouse.com/shop
- About: https://rosaryplanthouse.com/about
- Contact: https://rosaryplanthouse.com/contact
- FAQ: https://rosaryplanthouse.com/faq
- Policies: https://rosaryplanthouse.com/policies
- Reviews: https://rosaryplanthouse.com/reviews
- Sitemap: https://rosaryplanthouse.com/sitemap.xml
- Merchant feed: https://rosaryplanthouse.com/google-merchant-feed.tsv

## Ordering, Shipping And Support

- Service area: All over South India and major cities in North India.
- Dispatch days: Monday and Wednesday.
- Delivery ETA from dispatch: Bangalore 1-2 days from dispatch; Tamil Nadu 1-2 days from dispatch; South India 2-3 days from dispatch; Other serviceable major cities 4-5 days from dispatch.
- Payment: GPay, PayTM, PhonePe, Net banking. Cash on delivery is not available.
- Damage support: Transit-damaged plants are preferably replaced along with the customer next order when reported on the delivery day or the following day. Video is preferred; photos are also accepted. Replacement is preferred first, but a refund can be processed if the customer needs it.
- Support: Every day, 9 AM to 9 PM on WhatsApp at +91 79040 50237.
